LESSON: JACOB WRESTLES AN ANGEL

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.5: Jacob Wrestles an Angel

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Jacob Wrestles an Angel. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it good to pray always?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify values learnt from the story of Jacob

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify values learnt from the story of Jacob
   In simple words: practise until you can identify values learnt from the story of Jacob. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Jacob Wrestles an Angel using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Jacob Wrestles an Angel in the examples.
2. Explain Jacob Wrestles an Angel to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Jacob Wrestles an Angel.
4. Show that you can: identify values learnt from the story of Jacob

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Jacob Wrestles an Angel using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Jacob Wrestles an Angel important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In turns, read Genesis 32:22-30 and retell the story,
2. Role-play the story of Jacob wrestling with God,
3. Discuss lessons learnt from the story,
4. Discuss how they apply lessons learnt in their lives
5. Communication and collaboration: the skill of teamwork is enhanced as learners role-play the story of Jacob wrestling with God.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify values learnt from the story of Jacob

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
